what_was_done: Created OAuth platform modules for Meta, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest with token encryption
key_decisions: Used AES-256-GCM for token encryption with random IV per encryption
PKCE for X/Twitter only (others use standard OAuth2)
Meta exchanges short-lived for long-lived tokens
All platform modules follow same interface pattern
Used Node.js randomBytes instead of Web Crypto for code verifier generation
important_context: Client IDs stored in env vars: META_APP_ID, X_CLIENT_ID, LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID, TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY, PINTEREST_APP_ID
